1_recall_of_documented_inserts.what: fraction of documented unexpected inserts in the test split that the reduced-alphabet check flags, counting a flag as recovering an insert when it overlaps the resolved insert coordinates by at least one residue

2_false_flags_per_100_clean.what: flags raised on held-out clean constructs, per 100 clean constructs

3_comparison_missed_and_found.what: documented errors the reduced-alphabet check flags that exact tag matching, local alignment and the DNA check all miss

4_median_review_time_per_batch.what: change in the facility's recorded median review minutes per batch when the reduced-alphabet flags are added to the existing ones. Assessable only if the facility supplies review_minutes; a count of flagged regions is not a substitute and the threshold is then reported as not assessable, which is not a pass

fail_clauses.exact_already_catches: exact tag matching alone recovers at least as many documented unexpected inserts as the reduced-alphabet check
fail_clauses.cannot_separate_intended: flags cannot tell an insert the customer ordered from one that is a mistake: the share of intended inserts flagged is within 0.1 of the share of unintended inserts flagged
fail_clauses.needs_dna: every documented error the reduced-alphabet check finds beyond the comparison workflow is also found by the DNA check, so the protein method adds nothing the DNA already gives
